title: Define the puzzle generator and difficulty contract
context: Define how Sudoku puzzles are generated, validated, and graded.

spec.summary: Define the puzzle generator and difficulty contract
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: A puzzle schema is documented and versioned.
A seed produces the same puzzle.
Invalid puzzles are rejected with a reason.
Uniqueness is checked by the solver.
At least five fixtures cover valid and invalid cases.
Generator and solver share the validity check.
A puzzle with two solutions is rejected.
